prompts.hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Unity 2D character animation sprite sheet, transparent RGBA. Create ONE perfectly regular 4-column by 2-row sheet on a 1536x1024 canvas. Exactly eight cells, each 384x512, no visible grid, no text. Same original small charming scrap-yard scavenger robot in all eight cells: rounded ivory metal capsule body, dark navy faceplate with two mint eyes, ochre side ear bolts, small backpack, short dark articulated legs with chunky boots, little arms. Thick clean charcoal outline, flat two-tone cel shading, top-down arena game three-quarter/front view. Simple readable icon-scale silhouette, no gun in hands, no scarf, no props, no background or shadows. Character occupies middle 65 percent of each cell, same scale and horizontal center, feet baseline at 85 percent cell height. Top row left to right: four idle frames, relaxed stance, subtle breathing up/down and eye blink (open, half blink, closed, open). Bottom row: four walking frames, left foot forward/right back; passing pose; right foot forward/left back; passing pose. Clearly different leg positions and slight arm counter-swing, consistent head and body design. No perspective or camera changes between frames. Original game art, not a potato or any existing character. Preserve real transparent background.

No floor, no shadows, no backgrounds, no lettering, no objects outside cells. Distinguish role through silhouette and color; keep feet/base aligned within each row.

Objects individually centered and separated, consistent graphic style, no floor or backgrounds, REAL TRANSPARENT alpha. Each object wholly fits its cell, NOTHING touches adjacent cells. Maximum object width 180 pixels and height 230 pixels.

prompts.stats: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Unity upgrade stat icon atlas on genuine transparent canvas 1536x1024.
